operations.live: run macos-B320261025T013128Z-X8HkPg（oauth PROVEN → PAIRED → MAPPED → 触发 completed → control.activeWorks 观察到守卫 id（primaryTurn）→ stop outcome accepted → 历史 verdict STOPPED:interrupt-accepted（仅按 ACK；当前探针要求 guard-cleared））
operations.terminalEvidence: ack-only（历史 run）：stop 帧恰 1、ack accepted、stopTarget kind=primaryTurn、duplicateInboundFrames=0；run 在 ACK 后约 4ms teardown，未观察 control.activeWorks 中守卫执行消失 → 执行停止未证。2026-10-25 复审后探针新增终态观察窗：必须等 controlRevision 前进且守卫 id 不在 activeWorks，才报 STOPPED:interrupt-confirmed；否则只报 ACCEPTED:interrupt-unconfirmed。
operations.unknownRule: 受理但窗口内无结果 → 只记 unknown，绝不重发；guard.stopTargetChanged 等 noop 不算成功、不补发

operations.claim: 在 channel "zcode-agent" 的 v4 命令信封里发 type:"switchModelConfig"，payload 恰为 {provider, model, thought}；CAS 必带 baseRevision、禁止 baseLogEpoch。目录只认 model-selection.getView() 的 providerId / models[].modelId；档位必须取目标模型自己的 optionSpecs.reasoningLevel.values（禁止 provider 级并集）。只允许当前会话 provider（账号）内切换。ACK accepted ≠ 投影生效：必须等新 snapshot/delta 的 config 确认。
operations.live: runs macos-B320261025T030637Z-bS5dOg（model GLM-5.3-Flash→GLM-5.3，thought=max，ack accepted，fresh snapshot confirmed，restored）与 macos-B320261025T025928Z-3WyTFA（thought max→low→max，fresh snapshot confirmed）
operations.terminalEvidence: fresh conversation snapshot/delta 的 config.{provider,model,thought} 等于目标值；恢复原值仅探针清理（生产应保留用户选择），不是本轮生产行为
operations.unknownRule: ACK 后窗口内无新 snapshot → 只记 unknown/未确认，绝不重发；noop config.unchanged = 已是目标值；stale revision 需按 revisionAtDecision 重取 CAS；provider.notInRegistry → failed

capabilityNotes.approval: live-proven for ANSWERING an existing card: approve run macos-B320261025T032425Z-K7I6ZA (real kind=permission card, 3 options incl. fullAccess which is hard-blocked; allow-once → ack accepted → /tmp file deleted) and reject run macos-B320261025T034803Z-noorSA (deny → ack accepted → file remained). Elicitation precondition: cards only appeared for USER-composed submissions in 变更前确认 (guarded) mode; synthetic terminal-originated sendText (default or mode=guarded) did not prompt in this build. Therefore approvalForTerminalSend=false; production must not advertise guarded mode as protecting Tuvis sends.
